description: Enroll leads in automatic enrichment: each is re-read about once a month, free, with change signals when something moves. Nothing is enrolled on its own, so ask the user before enrolling, and offer it after a search for the leads that matched (only_matches). The plan holds up to three months of its leads enrolled; leads past that room are not enrolled and the answer says how many. A lead already read is enrolled for nothing; one never read (an import) is read first at one token per five. Already-enrolled leads and leads without a website are skipped at no cost. When a read is needed it runs in the background and returns a job id: poll get_job_status with kind "enrich".

only_matches.description: Leave out leads not judged a match for their search (relevance other than yes). Use it unless the user asks for all.

name: enroll_leads
title: Enroll in enrichment
